title: Pi Sandbox Configuration (bubblewrap tier)
description: Configuration for the always-on bubblewrap sandbox (bash only). File paths: ~/.pi/agent/extensions/sandbox.json (global) and <cwd>/.pi/sandbox.json (project-local), merged with project taking precedence. The Gondolin escalation tier has its own schema (sandbox-gondolin.json). Static (filesystem) and dynamic (network) sections are honored by @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime: bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS.

enabled.description: Master toggle for the always-on sandbox. When false, pi degrades loudly to the static permission layer (curated global bash denies + path deny list + external_directory ask still apply).

network.description: Network egress policy. Connections to domains NOT in allowedDomains are blocked at the syscall layer (bubblewrap/seccomp).

allowedDomains.description: Domains that bash subprocesses may connect to. Wildcards supported (e.g. *.github.com). Defaults include npm/pypi registries and GitHub.

deniedDomains.description: Hard-denied domains, evaluated in addition to allowedDomains (deny wins).

filesystem.description: Filesystem restrictions for bash subprocesses. Path tools (read/write/edit) are NOT covered by this tier — they run host-side and use the permission-system extension rules. Use --sandbox (Gondolin) for full-tool isolation.

denyRead.description: Host paths bash subprocesses may NOT read. ~ is expanded. Defaults: ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.gnupg.

allowWrite.description: Host paths bash subprocesses may write to. Defaults: . (workspace) and /tmp.

denyWrite.description: Glob patterns for paths bash subprocesses may NOT write even if inside allowWrite. Defaults: .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key.

ignoreViolations.description: sandbox-runtime advanced field: per-process ignore lists for violation logging.

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: sandbox-runtime advanced field: relax constraints when running inside an existing sandbox/container (use only if you understand the implications).
